File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Modify the toast component to ensure that error messages are announced immediately and remain visible until dismissed.

label: feature
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The current toast implementation does not adequately handle error messages for screen readers, which should be addressed by enhancing the accessibility features.
